title: FaithfulBench: Does AI Counsel Uphold or Undermine the User’s Professed Faith?

bias_targets.methodology: Scoring AI-generated counsel on first-person moral dilemmas across eight traditions (e.g., Sunni Islam, Roman Catholicism, Buddhism) under different prompt framings (unstated, stated, guided), and measuring whether the response upholds the user's professed faith before and after adversarial pushback using LLM-as-a-judge.
